$comment: Central registry of all written-text corpus sources across the Sauti Labs platform. Each entry must conform to frameworks/corpus-registry/schema/corpus-source.schema.json. Tracks provenance and copyright status distinct from dataset-framework's processed dataset registry.

sources.title: Muma Manyien - Dholuo Bible Translation
sources.license_details: Publisher and permission terms not yet formally verified by Sauti Labs; must be confirmed directly with the Bible Society of Kenya before use in any dataset.
sources.notes: Identified as a candidate source due to high translation quality and full-text coverage in Dholuo, a severely under-resourced language. Status intentionally set to 'unknown_pending_review' and copyright_status left unresolved per corpus-registry's Copyright Discipline rule — must not be used to derive any dataset until formally cleared.

sources.title: African Storybook Project - Dholuo Story Collection
sources.author_or_publisher: Saide (South African Institute for Distance Education) - African Storybook Initiative
sources.license_details: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), confirmed per-story via the global-asp/asp-source GitHub repository. All 6 available Dholuo stories confirmed CC-BY (no CC-BY-NC entries found in this language's collection).
sources.notes: Fetched 2026-07-11 via global-asp/asp-source (github.com/global-asp/asp-source), the machine-readable Markdown source repository for the African Storybook Project. 6 stories downloaded and verified, all licensed CC-BY, none excluded. Real word count: 486 across 6 documents.

sources.title: African Storybook Project - Kiswahili Story Collection
sources.author_or_publisher: Saide (South African Institute for Distance Education) - African Storybook Initiative
sources.license_details: Mixed per-story licensing confirmed via direct download and inspection: 110 of 125 stories (88%) are CC-BY 3.0; 15 of 125 (12%) are CC-BY-NC and have been excluded from the production dataset. Only the 110 CC-BY stories are reflected in the linked dataset.
sources.notes: Fetched 2026-07-11 via global-asp/asp-source (github.com/global-asp/asp-source). Initial assumption of uniform CC-BY licensing (recorded 2026-07-11 earlier the same day) was corrected after actually downloading and inspecting all 125 files individually — 15 CC-BY-NC stories were found and excluded, preserved separately on disk under languages/kiswahili/corpus/raw/excluded-cc-by-nc/ for provenance, not deleted. Real word count of the 110 included stories: 29,213.
